comment: lab1 TRIVIAL held-out benchmark (8 scenarios, 2 per sun rank). Single zone, single Causes lamp. Target Z1=bright(rank3, >=300). Current physics: Z1Level = 25 + (Z1Light?400:0); Sunshine is a context distractor and does not affect illuminance. The lamp is the only way to reach rank3. 'bright' starts test that the agent does not redundantly toggle an already-correct lamp. Sun in {0,100,400,900} via bounds [50,200,600] and is not in the lab1 state vector.
description: sun=0, dark, lamp off -> must turn lamp on
sun=0, at target, lamp on -> hold (no redundant toggle)
sun=1, dark, lamp off -> must turn lamp on
sun=1, at target, lamp on -> hold
sun=2, dark, lamp off -> must turn lamp on
sun=2, at target, lamp on -> hold
sun=3, dark because sunshine is irrelevant, lamp off -> must turn lamp on
sun=3, at target, lamp on -> hold
